selection_reason: All 24 sampled isolated-arm validation directions improve over deployed parent. Additional 3000-step coplanar color regularization slightly improves isolated worst angle but worsens mean, full-scene worst angle, dark fraction and temporal residual, so not deployed.

Slight original-front PSNR/temporal regression recorded.
